  "screen_decision": "include",
  "screen_rationale": "The study performs a systematic review comparing treatment effects in animal experiments with clinical trials, reporting quantitative measures of agreement (e.g., effect sizes, odds ratios) for multiple intervention-indication pairs. It explicitly evaluates the concordance between animal model results and human clinical outcomes.",
  "arm": "efficacy",
  "arm_evidence": "The study examines 'concordance between treatment effects in animal experiments and clinical trials' for various interventions, directly assessing if animal models predict human treatment benefit.",
  "therapeutic_areas": [
    "neurology-stroke",
    "respiratory",
    "musculoskeletal"
  ],
  "areas_evidence": "The study covers interventions for head injury, antifibrinolytics in haemorrhage, thrombolysis in acute ischaemic stroke, tirilazad in acute ischaemic stroke, antenatal corticosteroids to prevent neonatal respiratory distress syndrome, and bisphosphonates to treat osteoporosis.",
  "model_type": "across-multiple-models",
  "model_evidence": "The study reviews multiple interventions, each with its own set of animal models (e.g., animal models of traumatic head injury, animal models of acute ischaemic stroke, animal models of preterm delivery, animal models of osteoporosis).",
  "species": [
    "mouse",
    "rat",
    "cattle",
    "rabbit",
    "non-human-primate"
  ],
  "species_evidence": "The text mentions studies in 'animal models of traumatic head injury', 'animal models of acute ischaemic stroke', 'animal models of preterm delivery' (including monkeys, cattle, and rabbits), and 'animal models' for bisphosphonates (baboons and rats).",
  "endpoint_class": "mixed",
  "endpoint_evidence": "The study reports on outcomes such as mortality, functional outcome (grip test, neurobehavioural scores), infarct volume, and bone mineral density, which represent a mix of primary hard endpoints and secondary biomarkers."
}
